sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def piece_bbox(frame):
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('p','W') and 50 < n['pixels'] < 200:
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            if min(rs)<20: continue
            if min(rs)>=33 and max(rs)<=45 and min(cs)>=26 and max(cs)<=38: continue
            return (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
    return None
pos = piece_bbox(current_frame)
print('start', pos)
for a in ['DOWN','LEFT']:
    action([a])
    np = piece_bbox(current_frame)
    print(a, '->', np)
    if np != pos: pos = np
# now try RIGHT and UP to see mapping at current pos
for a in ['RIGHT','UP']:
    action([a])
    np = piece_bbox(current_frame)
    print(a, '->', np)
    pos = np
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def piece_bbox(frame):
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('p','W') and 50 < n['pixels'] < 200:
